_meta.filter: litellm_provider in {bedrock, bedrock_converse}; input_cost_per_token and output_cost_per_token both non-null; sample_spec excluded; bedrock/ prefix stripped from keys; keys containing / after strip excluded (non-routeable region/routing prefixes). Result = token-priced, routeable Bedrock model IDs incl. token-priced embeddings (input>0, output 0). NOTE: entries with BOTH token costs 0 (e.g. rerank) carry no billing value and are dropped by gen_pricing.py (Pass-1 guard); the documented jq additionally drops them at refresh time.
